diagnosis_explanation: Your neck has some pain. It also affects your right arm. This is called radiculopathy. Your neck bones have changes. These are from getting older. There are also discs that have moved out of place. These are in your neck in a few spots. This is called a herniated nucleus pulposus. It means a soft part of a neck bone cushion has pushed out. This is pinching a nerve. It can cause pain. It can also cause numbness. It can cause weakness in your arm. There is also less space in your neck. This is called stenosis. It makes the pinching worse.
medication_rationale:
Morphine - stopping:
Your doctor wants you to stop taking this medicine. It was used to manage severe pain during your stay. Do not take it until your doctor tells you it is safe to start again.

Decadron:
This medicine is a steroid. It helps to reduce swelling and inflammation in your neck. This can help ease pressure on your nerves. You might notice an increase in your appetite. You may also feel more restless or have trouble sleeping. Call your doctor if you have stomach pain, black or bloody stools, or severe mood changes.

Medrol:
This medicine is a steroid. It helps to reduce swelling and inflammation in your neck. This can ease pressure on your nerves and help with pain. You might notice you feel more hungry than usual. You may also have trouble sleeping or feel more restless. Call your doctor if you get a fever, chills, or have stomach pain.

Darvocet:
This medicine is a pain reliever. It helps to manage your neck pain. You may feel drowsy or sleepy. This is normal as the medicine works. Call your doctor if you have trouble breathing or feel very confused.

Flexeril:
This medicine is a muscle relaxant. It helps to calm muscle spasms in your neck. This can reduce pain and help you move more freely. You may feel drowsy or dizzy. This is common when the medicine is working. Call your doctor if you feel very weak, have a fast heartbeat, or trouble urinating.
escalation_guide:
CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY
These symptoms are life-threatening. Do not drive yourself.
- No symptoms in this tier for your diagnosis.

GO TO THE ER TODAY
Do not wait until tomorrow. Go within a few hours.
- Significant weakness or numbness: This can affect movement.
- Trouble with balance or walking: This can cause falls.
- Loss of bowel or bladder control: This needs urgent care.

CALL YOUR DOCTOR
Call during office hours. Do not go to the ER for these.
- Neck pain is not better: Call your doctor.
- Arm pain is not better: Call your doctor.
- Numbness or tingling is worse: Call your doctor.
- Trouble swallowing: Call your doctor.
- Fever with neck stiffness: Call your doctor.
